milestone_brief:
corpus-integrity-observability-e3 — Ingest throughput observable from /metrics

Type: value (enabler-flavored — closes the note-08 deferred metric stub). Size: M
(~150 LOC). Depends on e1 (m1+m2, SHIPPED) + spike-3 (DONE — the design is LOCKED).

THE DESIGN IS ALREADY DECIDED. Follow
.claude/notes/spikes/corpus-integrity-observability-spike-3/decision.md VERBATIM —
do not re-litigate the counter-vs-gauge question. Read decision.md + research.md
first; they cite exact file:line for every touch point.

Locked decisions (from spike-3 decision.md):
1. GAUGE (last-run-snapshot), NOT Counter. A sentinel-file Counter written by a
   cron process that exits between runs cannot hold a durable monotonic total
   (a corpus rebuild makes it go backwards → breaks the Counter contract). Gauge
   matches the cron-exits-between-runs reality.
2. Metric names (UNLABELED scalar gauges; note-08's _total counter names are
   OVERRIDDEN): arxmcp_ingest_last_run_papers, arxmcp_ingest_last_run_chunks,
   arxmcp_ingest_last_run_timestamp_seconds. NO {driver} Prometheus label (single
   overwritten sentinel + blanket-zero-on-absence would freeze a stale per-driver
   series); driver rides as a JSON field for the daily-report row only.
3. ingest-summary.json schema v1 (path var/arxmcp/ops/ingest-summary.json under
   config.ops_dir; atomic temp+os.replace like oai_delta._write_state; inherits
   the F1 64KB guard via _read_capped). Fields: schema_version, driver,
   finished_at (ISO-8601 UTC), elapsed_seconds, papers_processed, papers_succeeded,
   papers_failed, chunks_written_this_run, total_rows_after_commit.
4. WriteStats += paper_id + total_rows_after_commit (scout CAND-8; free — m1 already
   computes count_rows() in write_chunks).

Implementation surface (decision.md §"e3 implementation surface"):
- ingest/store.py — WriteStats fields + populate in write_chunks
- ingest/ingest_summary.py (NEW) — write_ingest_summary(ops_dir, driver, summary), atomic
- ingest/bulk_ingest.py — call it after run_bulk_ingest loop (success path)
- ingest/oai_delta.py — call it after run_delta success path
- server/metrics.py — INGEST_LAST_RUN_PAPERS / _CHUNKS / _TIMESTAMP gauges (unlabeled)
- server/health.py — refresh_sentinel_metrics += ingest-summary.json reader + _INGEST_SUMMARY_NAME
  (present → set gauges; malformed → WARN + leave prior; absent → set 0.0; mirror backup-status.json reader)
- tools/daily_metrics_report.py — replace the "Ingestion throughput" TODO stub with a real row
  reading the new gauges + driver
- .claude/notes/08-security-observability-ops.md — replace the two _total counter rows with the gauge names

Acceptance criteria:
- arxmcp_ingest_last_run_papers / _chunks / _timestamp_seconds reach /metrics via the
  ingest-summary.json sentinel read by refresh_sentinel_metrics.
- A real ingest run (bulk + delta) writes ingest-summary.json atomically with the v1 schema.
- WriteStats records paper_id + total_rows_after_commit.
- The daily report renders an Ingestion-throughput row (papers / chunks / driver / freshness)
  replacing the TODO stub; n/a when the sentinel is absent.
- note-08 updated (counters -> gauges); EXPECTED_TOOL_SCHEMA_SHA256 + EXPECTED_BP1_SHA256
  UNCHANGED (no MCP tool); make test green.
- Tests: writer (happy / missing-dir / atomic) + reader (present / absent / oversized / malformed)
  + the metrics-fixture regen.

Specialist: determinism-reviewer concern (the sentinel schema + WriteStats must be deterministic
and reconcile with the table) — but no specialist agent registered; the adversary critic suffices.

External writes: none (local sentinel under var/arxmcp/ops/, gitignored).
